title: Gindarra
meta_description: Pet Friendly with Private Pool, Near Beach- Gindarra by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Gindarra by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 188 Savelle Drive Details: Gindarra is a recently renovated, pet-friendly coastal retreat located in the highly sought-after Gulf Trace community of Grayton Beach. Surrounded by the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and the Gulf of Mexico, this inviting home comfortably accommodates up to 9 guests with four bedrooms and two full baths. Thoughtfully updated interiors, an open living area, and a fully equipped kitchen provide a comfortable setting for families and groups to gather and enjoy their time along 30A. Outdoor living is at the heart of Gindarra. Start the morning with coffee on the large screened front porch, spend the afternoon relaxing beside the private heated pool, or gather for dinner on the spacious back deck. Private neighborhood beach access is approximately a three-minute walk from the home, providing convenient access to the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf. With its peaceful Gulf Trace setting, private pool, and proximity to Grayton Beach State Park, Gindarra offers a relaxing home base for your next 30A getaway. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 3-Minute Walk to Private Neighborhood Beach Access -Parking Spaces: (4), Covered and Open Parking -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Bar Seating for 3, Outdoor Dining for 6 -Coffee Maker Available: Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker -Private Heated Pool* -*Pet Friendly with approval -Borders Grayton Beach State Park -Large Screened Front Porch -Spacious Back Deck -Outdoor Dining Area -Outdoor Gas Gril *Additional pet fee of $350 per pet (plus tax) applies. Prior approval is required; please contact Reservations before your stay. *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per night and must be arranged prior to arrival. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 9 4 Bedrooms / 2 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 2 (Bunk Room): Twin/Twin Bunk with Twin Trundle and Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Shared Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Laundry Closet -Screened Front Porch -Back Deck Please Note: *LSVs and on-street parking are prohibited within the Gulf Trace neighborhood. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
